definitions.explanation: The act of dividing and distributing something among multiple recipients, such as profits, resources, or tasks.

examples.japanese: {利益|りえき}を{分配|ぶんぱい}する。
{食料|しょくりょう}を{公平|こうへい}に{分配|ぶんぱい}した。
{富|とみ}の{分配|ぶんぱい}が{不均等|ふきんとう}であることが{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: The unequal distribution of wealth has become a social issue.

notes:
Compound of {分|ぶん} (to divide) + {配|ぱい} (to distribute). Used in economic, social, and everyday contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{分配|ぶんぱい}する (to distribute, to allocate)
・{利益|りえき}の{分配|ぶんぱい} (profit distribution)
・{富|とみ}の{分配|ぶんぱい} (distribution of wealth)
・{所得|しょとく}{分配|ぶんぱい} (income distribution)
・{再|さい}{分配|ぶんぱい} (redistribution)
・{均等|きんとう}に{分配|ぶんぱい}する (to distribute evenly)
・{分配|ぶんぱい}{金|きん} (dividend, distribution payment)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{分配|ぶんぱい}: distributing shares to multiple recipients (emphasis on giving portions to each)
・{配分|はいぶん}: allocation, apportioning (emphasis on deciding how much goes where)
・{配布|はいふ}: handing out, distributing (printed materials, goods — not dividing a total)
